application-summary list-all-application.help:
Lists all the available listings and private applications in a compartment. A new API for catalog manager use when creating/updating a service catalog. 
[Command Reference](listAllApplications)

params.name: compartment_id
params.help: The unique identifier for the compartment.

params.name: entity_type
params.help: The type of the application in the service catalog.

params.name: limit
params.help: How many records to return. Specify a value greater than zero and less than or equal to 1000. The default is 30.

params.name: page
params.help: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: display_name
params.help: Exact match name filter.

params.name: entity_id
params.help: The unique identifier of the entity associated with service catalog.

params.name: publisher_id
params.help: Limit results to just this publisher.

params.name: package_type
params.help: Name of the package type. If multiple package types are provided, then any resource with one or more matching package types will be returned.

params.name: pricing
params.help: Name of the pricing type. If multiple pricing types are provided, then any resource with one or more matching pricing models will be returned.

params.name: is_featured
params.help: Indicates whether to show only featured resources. If this is set to `false` or is omitted, then all resources will be returned.

params.name: sort_order
params.help: The sort order to apply, either `ASC` or `DESC`. Default is `ASC`.

params.name: all_pages
params.help: Fetches all pages of results. If you provide this option, then you cannot provide the --limit option.

params.name: page_size
params.help: When fetching results, the number of results to fetch per call. Only valid when used with --all or --limit, and ignored otherwise.

private-application change-compartment.help:
Moves the specified private application from one compartment to another. 
[Command Reference](changePrivateApplicationCompartment)

params.name: private_application_id
params.help: The unique identifier for the private application. [required]

params.name: compartment_id
params.help: The [OCID] of the compartment where you want to move the private application.

params.name: if_match
params.help: For optimistic concurrency control. In the PUT or DELETE call for a resource, set the `if-match` parameter to the value of the etag from a previous GET or POST response for that resource.  The resource will be updated or deleted only if the etag you provide matches the resource's current etag value.

params.name: wait_for_state
params.help: This operation asynchronously creates, modifies or deletes a resource and uses a work request to track the progress of the operation. Specify this option to perform the action and then wait until the work request reaches a certain state. Multiple states can be specified, returning on the first state. For example, --wait-for-state ACCEPTED --wait-for-state SUCCEEDED would return on whichever lifecycle state is reached first. If timeout is reached, a return code of 2 is returned. For any other error, a return code of 1 is returned.

params.name: max_wait_seconds
params.help: The maximum time to wait for the work request to reach the state defined by --wait-for-state. Defaults to 1200 seconds.

params.name: wait_interval_seconds
params.help: Check every --wait-interval-seconds to see whether the work request has reached the state defined by --wait-for-state. Defaults to 30 seconds.
